simple.meaning: מָכוֹן (mâkôwn) appears 17 times in the Hebrew Scriptures as a person-name in the Hebrew text.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Ezra, Psalms, and 2 more, beginning at Exodus 15:17. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as mountain, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָכוֹן (H4349) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מָכוֹן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: מָכוֹן (mâkôwn) / H4349 is tracked through Exodus 15:17, 1 Kings 8:13, 1 Kings 8:39, 1 Kings 8:43. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

timeline.evidenceText: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance,
I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

then hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and forgive, and act, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of all the children of men);

hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.
then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause;
But I have built you a house and home, a place for you to dwell in forever.”
then hear from heaven your dwelling place and forgive, and render to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of the children of men)

then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.
then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their petitions, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.
Some of the heads of fathers’ households, when they came to Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for God’s house to set it up in its place.
From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you.
Clouds and darkness are around him.
He laid the foundations of the earth,
Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.
For Yahweh said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”
Yes, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the army; and it took away from him the continual burnt offering, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

definitions.full: H4349. makon מָכוֺן noun masculine Dan 8:11 fixed or established place, foundation (chiefly in poetry); — absolute ׳מ Exod 15:17 2 t.; construct מְכוֺן 1Kin 8:39 10 t.; suffix מְכוֺנִי Isa 18:4 , מְכוֺנוֺ Ezra 2:68 ; plural suffix מְכוֺנֶיהָ Psa 104:5 ; — 1 fixed place of ׳י s abode on earth Exod 15:17 (song), 1Kin 8:13 2Chr 6:2 (poetic fragment: see ᵐ5 and Dr Intr. 182 ); = place , or site of God's house Ezra 2:68 ; הַרצִֿיּוֺן כָּלמְֿכוֺן Isa 4:5 , apparently = all the extent of Mt. Zion; redund. (si vera lectio) מִקְדָּשׁוֺ מְכוֺן וְהֻשְׁלַךְ Dan 8:11 and the place of his sanctuary shall be thrown down (on difficulties of see, see Bev); of heavens שִׁבְתְּךָ מְכוֺן 1Kin 8:39 , 43 , 49 2Chr 6:30 , 33 , 39 , compare Psa 33:14 ; מְכוֺנִי alone Isa 18:4 ; figurative כִּסְאֶ֑ךָ מְכוֺן וּמִשְׁמָּט צֶדֶק Psa 89:15 , so 97:2 . 2 foundation , only plural, in poetry עַלמְֿכוֺנֶיהָ אֶרֶץ יָסַד Psa 104:5 .
